title: Gensyn (AIGENSYN) Listing Will Be Further Postponed
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Due to an issue with the project team’s deposit node, the trading start time for Gensyn (AIGENSYN), originally set at 2026-05-14 13:00 (UTC) ,  will be further postponed to  2026-05-14 17:00 (UTC). For More Information:  Binance Will List Gensyn (AIGENSYN) with Seed Tag Applied Gensyn (AIGENSYN) Listing Will Be Postponed Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-05-14
